blocks.note: `Ubr`, the text-style prop names (dimColor, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, inverse, borderDimColor). `Ago` (2) sits between this and the next block and is referenced by nothing here, so the run is split rather than taken whole.
`rQt`, the border prop names (`new Set(PFs)` — the border table the W44 tui copy already carries) and `Cgo`, the colour ones (color, backgroundColor, borderColor)
`Rgo`, the flex and spacing prop names, and `olt`, the four sides
`xgo`, the per-prop validator table `sQt` looks a name up in — the largest single body of this package
`slt` (10000), the tolerance a number is compared with, and `oQt`, the size prop names (width, height, minWidth, minHeight)

`sQt`, the prop validator: a name looked up in `xgo`, whose answer is either a sentence or a predicate that is run against the value — the table holds both, which is why the name is checked before the value
`Ybr` (1e5), how many characters a described value may serialize to. `B3e` ("AskUserQuestion") sits between this and the next block and is referenced by nothing here.
`ESe` (32), how deep the describer walks, and `AFe` (20000), how many values it may visit
`cN`, the short description of a value — null, an array, an object, or `a <typeof>` — which is the sentence a leaf drops into its own when a prop had the wrong shape
`Vs`, the largest length a plugin's list may claim
`B`, the list length a plugin declares, which throws `He` rather than answering when the claim is not a length any list has — the one body here that refuses instead of describing
`fa`, the generator the describer walks with: an array yields each element under the key length one, an object yields its own keys at their own length plus four (`"key":` and the comma)
the budget and its three bounds: `F$n` (1e5 characters), `Xbr` (32 deep), `Jbr` (20000 values), and `Ro`, a fresh walk budget — a path Set for cycles and a done Map for values already seen
`ca`, the budget check: more than 20000 values answers `holds more than 20000 values`, more than 1e5 characters answers `serializes to more than 100000 characters`, and otherwise nothing
`un`, what a scalar costs the budget: a boolean is 5 (`false`), a string its length plus two quotes, a number the length of its text, and null 5 — anything else answers nothing and is walked instead

`Dt`, the describer itself: it walks the value against the budget, spending `un` on scalars and recursing through `fa`, tracking the path to cut a cycle and the done Map to cut a repeat, and answers either the serialized text or the budget sentence
`cQt`, the describer at its entry: `Dt(value, 0, Ro())` — depth zero and a fresh budget
